categories.title: Null or empty alternative text
categories.summary: Alternative text is null or empty (alt="").

categories.title: Linked image with alternative text
categories.summary: Alternative text is present for an image that is within a link.

categories.title: Skip link
categories.summary: A link is present which allows users to skip over navigation or other content.

categories.title: Skip link target
categories.summary: A target for a "skip" link is present.

categories.title: Language
categories.summary: The language of the document or a page element is identified.

categories.title: Heading level 1
categories.summary: A first level heading (<h1> element) is present.

categories.title: Navigation
categories.summary: A <nav> element or navigation landmark is present.

categories.title: Main content
categories.summary: A <main> element or main landmark is present.

categories.title: Footer
categories.summary: A <footer> element or contentinfo landmark is present.

categories.title: ARIA
categories.summary: An ARIA role, state, or property is present.

categories.title: ARIA label
categories.summary: An aria-label or aria-labelledby attribute is present.

categories.title: ARIA tabindex
categories.summary: A tabindex value of 0 or less is present.

categories.title: ARIA button
categories.summary: An element with role="button" is present.
